main_body: prehistoric palm/cycad tree with crown and straight trunk
top_band: upper crown bud and top-facing fronds in light-to-mid green (rows 1-10)
evidence: The crown shows a rounded central bud and radiating fronds viewed from slightly above (rows 1-10), overhanging the lower drooping fronds and shaded upper trunk (rows 11-54).

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, organically clustered leaf clumps and flared roots of the Beodeul reference trees, the candidate has a very stiff, ruler-straight vertical trunk with a repetitive 4-row tile pattern and heavy near-black outlines around every frond and the central bud, giving it a flat sticker-like appearance.
